name: Input contract
risk: Invalid requests can become misleading financial results.
contract: Require plan_id, service and amount_cents. Only active, in_network, authorized and formulary may additionally be supplied, defaulting to true. Identifiers must be strings, plan_id must be known, service must be a known catalog service, amount_cents must be a positive built-in integer no greater than 100000000, and all flags must be actual booleans. Reject malformed input with HTTP 400. No claim is stored.

name: Active coverage
risk: Payment for an inactive teaching policy.
contract: An inactive policy returns decision denied and reason INACTIVE_POLICY, before any benefit or network check.

name: Service benefit
risk: Payment for a service missing from the chosen contract.
contract: Use plans.json as the authoritative synthetic matrix. A known service not listed in the selected plan returns denied / SERVICE_NOT_COVERED. Part C and Medicare Advantage are the same category. These service lists are teaching fixtures, not actual coverage determinations.

name: Network control
contract: When network_required is true and in_network is false, return denied / OUT_OF_NETWORK. Other plans accept either network flag with identical simplified payout; real emergency exceptions and cost sharing are outside V1.

name: Prior authorization
risk: Approving a claim without the required teaching authorization.
contract: If service appears in authorization_services and authorized is false, return denied / AUTH_REQUIRED. Check this after service coverage and network.

name: Drug formulary
risk: Accepting a prescription outside the synthetic formulary.
contract: For a covered prescription service, formulary false returns denied / NON_FORMULARY. For other services, the flag has no effect. Check after network and authorization.

name: Payout calculation
risk: Overpayment, negative payout, or policy-limit bypass.
contract: For an otherwise accepted request, payout_cents = min(max(amount_cents - deductible_cents, 0), limit_cents). Read deductible and limit from plans.json. All V1 plans deliberately use a synthetic 10000-cent deductible and 200000-cent cap per evaluation. At or below the deductible, return approved / COVERED with zero payout. This is not an annual accumulator, actual Medicare deductible, allowed-amount calculation, or real benefit payment.
